title: BMS master board — Teensy A + B, 6× SN65HVD230, 5 V buck, LEM dividers, throttle clamp, LM339, MCP23017
notes: PROPOSED (Gilfoyle 2026-10-23, Build 21). Generated by tools/boards/gen_bms_master.py from docs/PINMAP.yaml + docs/THROTTLE_CLAMP.md; every net desc cites its PINMAP wire id. Edit in tools/perfboard.html, Export JSON, commit here.
Board 70×82 holes = 177.8 × 208.3 mm (7.0 × 8.2 in) incl. a 2-hole margin; M3 mounts at the four corners.

GROUND: ONE signal-ground star BAR (18 AWG bare, bottom side) BC24–BC36; star holes BC24, BC26, BC28, BC30, BC32, BC34, BC36. Each ground group (power/buck, CAN A, CAN B, Teensy A, Teensy B, clamp, analog) lands on ONE star hole and touches no other group — same single-point rule as coil_driver's V22 star (PINMAP S49). J-PWR.2 is the only lead to TB-GND (G03, buck OUT−). Teensy A signal ground leaves only on J-DRV.1 -> coil_driver J-SIG.1 (DECIDED room 06:11; G04 dropped).

Zones: CAN + buck on the left/right/top edges; analog (LEM/pedal dividers, LM339, PROX) bottom-right, kept ≥8 holes (20 mm) from any SN65 module, CAN terminator, fuse or the buck (see test_perfboard).

Teensy A/B: VIN/VUSB pad CUT on both (P11/P12) — they run from the board 5 V bus. SN65 module pin order (3V3/GND/TX/RX | CANH/CANL) UNVERIFIED — check your module silkscreen and remove any on-module 120 Ω except RT-equivalents (OPEN).

Top = insulated solid-core jumpers (may pass under the Teensy/SN65 headers); bottom = wire on the solder side. Soldered at every vertex. Wire gauges: 20 AWG power/ground, 22 AWG signal, 18 AWG star bar.
Release detect (LM339 comparators 3/4, ~1.40 V threshold from the lm339 PARTS spec) outputs go to J-REL only: the Teensy pins are OPEN (not in PINMAP).
BMS_CAP 0 / TELEMETRY_ONLY 1 — this board does not change any limit; firmware is not flashed (no flashing).

GND.desc: ONE signal ground, single STAR BAR (18 AWG, bottom side). Each ground group (power/buck, CAN A, CAN B, Teensy A + ESP + coil_driver SGND + expander, Teensy B, clamp, analog) joins the bar by ONE wire and nowhere else (S49 'single-point ground'; same rule as coil_driver's V22 star). J-PWR.2 is the board's only ground lead to TB-GND (G03). Teensy A signal ground leaves on J-DRV.1 -> coil_driver J-SIG.1 (DECIDED room 2026-10-23 06:11, G04: no Teensy GND wire at TB-GND).

offboard.short: ESP32 is OFF-BOARD: J-ESP 1 = A:17 TX, 2 = GND, 3 = +5 V
offboard.text: ESP32 telemetry module is NOT on this board. J-ESP.1 = Teensy A:17 Serial4 TX -> ESP32 GPIO16 RX (S30, TX-only link); J-ESP.2 = GND (G05, from the Teensy A ground group); J-ESP.3 = +5 V board bus (P08). TELEMETRY_ONLY 1.
